Hidden limits of traditional Power BI
Why Fabric isn't just another tool

takeaways: Scheduled-refresh Power BI reporting no longer meets expectations for live operational analytics.
Microsoft Fabric puts Power BI on a unified platform with OneLake, pipelines, warehouses and lakehouses, so BI pros can shape data upstream.
A developer or trial tenant lets you test OneLake datasets, Direct Lake and KQL queries against streams in a safe sandbox.
hook: If your Power BI dashboards still wait for overnight refreshes, your skills may no longer cover what leaders expect. This episode shows BI professionals how Microsoft Fabric, OneLake and KQL databases widen their role, and how to start with a sandbox tenant and small experiments.
